pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal dark regions with smooth pixel gradients at edges. Patches on the lower neck are significantly more elongated than the smaller, more compact polygons on the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of off-white inter-patch pathways. Junction nodes typically connect three to four patches. Pathway pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, narrowing slightly toward the dorsal ridge.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette visible along the dorsal neck and shoulder transition against the background foliage.
